verse: kaḥ kramaḥ kiṃ kramasyāsya jñeyaṃ jñānaṃ tu kiṃ bhavet | ke siddhāstasya tattvasya kramavijñānabhāvagāḥ
kālī tu bhairavārūḍhā mahākālakalāśinī | vyomarūpā anantākhyā aṣṭamūrtidharā śivā
saṃhārād dvitīyaṃ sṛṣṭeraṣṭamaṃ sthitisaṃyutam | etat tayodaśavarṇaṃ viddhi bhairava tattvataḥ
visargāntakalārūḍhā ṣoḍaśasvaramadhyagā | saptādaśīti sā kālī kriyā sarvāntakī kalā
śrībhairavyuvāca tvatprītyā kālakācānta vidhānaṃ kramaśāsane | kathayāmi samāsena kramavijñānabhāsakam
saṃmuktaḥ sarvaduḥkhebhyaścakreśatvalabhed dhruvam | tatastu pūjayeccakraṃ vīradravyaiśca cottamaiḥ
aṭane sarvajantūnāṃ haṭhajñānena khegatā | khaṇḍakhaṇḍakamadhyasthā khaṇḍakākārabhakṣikā
kā pūjyā tasya tat yasya deśākātānigamya ca | kaiḥ siddhaiḥ sṛṣṭicakraṃ tu pūjyate tattvadarśibhiḥ
tasmin sthāne ca suramye ādau pūjāṃ tu kārayet | yoginīnāṃ yathā nyāyaṃ ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu ekataḥ
kālāntare tu saṃprāpte vakṣyāmi tu yathā tathyam  ||1/ 53 ||
tatra protā tu sā kalā nirācārā ninādī yā | arūpā ambarā kālī tithyante svasvabhāvataḥ
sṛṣṭicakrasya madhyasthā pūjā bhasmavilepanaiḥ | puṣpadhūpopahāraiśca vīradravyaiśca sarvataḥ
na mantro na ca vā vidyā na madhyamakṣaraṃ na ca | na tattvaṃ na ca ekasthaṃ na ca sarvagataṃ priye
etat jñātvā tu vīreṇa pūjayed bhava tattvataḥ | yena pūjitamātreṇa kālikākhyaṃ nirañjanam
arāsu vinyaset prājña saumyarūpāvibodhataḥ | tatastu sthiticakrasya varṇānyanyāni ṣoḍaśa
mattagandhakavāhasthe'aapānarūpe namo'stu te | ṣaṭcakravarjite kāli cakrānteśi namo'stu te
karṣayedavikalpena kalpamānā svakā kalā | tridhā mātṛvadā tryantā tāraṇī tatvamadhyagā
manane trāṇane ratā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | kakalākamalārūḍhā kākacañcupuṭiśritā
lakmīyugmaṃ tathā māyā mahāśabdamataḥ param | eṣā pañcākṣarī vidyā viddhi bhairava tattvataḥ
pūrvāntānāckamadhyasthā tataḥ proktā parā kalā | adhomārge dīrghaśiraṃ ukāraṃ sarvabhakṣakam
ūrdhvaṃ dvādaśage cakre parā sā bhairavīdaśā | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
mahāphalgurudhireṇa dhūpayedarghabhājanam | mahātailena dīpāni dāpayedathavā niśi
dvādaśa ca samāsena citsvarūpāḥ svarūpataḥ | srotrayorubhayormadhye parā yā citsvarūpiṇī
vadasva  tat samāsena yathāvidhiranukramāt ||2/16 ||
idaṃ praśnavaraṃ rudra akathyaṃ sarvajantuṣu ||1/ 44 ||
melāpe militā sā vai viharet paramā citiḥ | (8) apānavāyumāśritya dvādaśānte nirākulā
viddhi bhairavayā tattvena akramāṃ kramagocarām | tayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
prāptā tu paramā devyā mahāsiddhipradāstu tāḥ  ||2/19 ||
siddhijaṃ narakaṃ nīya mahārudhirapuritam | pūjayed dīrghapātraṃ tu niśadau cāmarastathā
sārabhūtaṃ kramārthasya mantroddhāramidaṃ param | yena vijñātamātreṇa mantrāmantravido bhavet
ālīḍhā ca nirālīḍhā  sālīḍhālīḍhakaiḥ saha ||2/30 ||
catvāraḥ sarvasāmānyāḥ niḥsvabhāvasvabhāvagāḥ | khaprāptāḥ parameśāni taṃ vadasva mamepsitam
vidmaheti padaṃ paścāt kālīśabdamataḥ param | tatastu saṃhaṃrṣa vidmeṣa dhāmahomiṣakaṃ tataḥ
sthitinavamasaṃyuktaṃ etad varṇaṃ caturthakam | tatastu sthiticakraṃ taṃ daśamaṃ viddhi pañcamam
sarvamantra-ārṇavaṃ guhyaṃ sarvavidyālayaṃ param | asya cakreśvarasyaiva sakṛt paśyati yo naraḥ
kathitāstu samāsena khecakre tu yathā matāḥ  ||2/22 ||
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu rudra pravakṣyāmi vidyāṃ teṣāṃ yathā sthitām | siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca sthiticakrasvarūpagā
asya bāhye tu vai rudra padmaṃ paścāt vicakṣaṇaḥ | ālikhyet tu punardivyaiścakraṃ cakravaraṃ mahat
akule ca tato rudra kule ca tadanantaram | bhariteti bhairaveti raveti tadanantaram
phalameva prayacchanti kālikājñānamuttamam | etat kramaṃ tu siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ mahātapa
mukhapāraṃparāgataṃ mukhānmukhagataṃ sadā | mukhāmukhapadau hīnaṃ saṃmukhaṃ tu adhomukham
ūrdhvaṃ bindudvayaṃ yasyā madhye bindudvayaṃ punaḥ | teṣu madhye sthitā kālī bhakṣakasya ca bhakṣikī
tarā madhye akāraṃ tu jñātvā khegatimāpnuyāt | tathyāntā manalāntā ca kuhūkāntā tathaiva ca
tato'aanyāni varṇāni ṣoḍaśāni trilocana | saṃhāracakre bhāvajña arāsu viniyojayet
sphurantī parame vyomni mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | adhyātmajñānarūpasya sadāntā paramāvyayā
svasvabhāvasamāviṣṭā jñānadāḥ parameśvara | śrībhairava uvāca ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu mūrtināṃ gūḍhaṃ sarvārthanāśanam
nāgraṃ nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ vā ānandānandavarjitam | na ca kandagataṃ deva na cakrapadmagocaram
sṛṣṭisaptamakaṃ nātha saṃhārasyāṣṭame yutam | ekādhikadaśaṃ viddhi sarvakāmaphalapradam
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇvemāṃ paramāṃ kālīvidyāṃ sṛṣṭisvabhāvataḥ | puruṣāṃ viśvarūpāṃ ca dvyaṣṭaikakalasaṃyutām
tatastu paramaṃ tattvaṃ prāptaṃ tu paramaṃ śivam  ||1/ 67 ||
aṣṭau devyastu yāḥ proktāḥ yoginīyogacakragāḥ | śāktamārgena saṃprāptāḥ khecaratvagatirdhruvam
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyante tūryānteśi namo'stu te | sarve sarveśvareśyante nirādhāre nirāmaye
durvijñeyaṃ durārādhyaṃ sarvadhā  sarvajantuṣu ||1/ 49 ||
āpyāyakāriṇi tataḥ proktaṃ tat tu vicakṣaṇaḥ | sthitiśabdastatodhṛtya bodhaśabdaṃ tataḥ param
sthiticakraṃ tu jānīyād ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu adhunā śṛṇu | sṛṣṭiprathamagaṃ varṇaṃ saṃhārādaṣṭameyutam
caturviṃśatiryāḥ (?) devi kena mantreṇa khecarāḥ | prakaṭaṃ paramārthena tad vadasva yathārthataḥ
yena vijñātamātreṇa bhāvāmi kramabhājanaḥ | anugrahaṃ kuru me devi siddhapāraṃparāyatam
sarvabhūteṣu bhāvajñe na prakāśyamanopamam ||1/ 51 ||
jñānaṃ tu paramaṃ devī śrutaṃ me tvatprasādataḥ | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa vidhānataḥ
viśvanirmātṛrūpatvaṃ divyamānandarūpiṇam | kalā rūpāntā ekā vai catuḥṣaṣṭyantagā śivā
mūrtayaśca mahāraudrāḥ śūnyarūpāḥ svabhāvataḥ | jñātāstetvatprasādādye ṣaṭcakrapadadeśikāḥ
pretaiśca kinnaraiḥ sarvai bhīṣaṇaistu mahābalaiḥ | ḍākinī rākinī caiva lākinī kākinī tathā
tritattvabhāvakī yā tu mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | yasyā nāsti paraṃ jñānaṃ yatra jñeyaṃ parāparam
kaṇṭhadeśe tu nityasthe kṣudhāharti namo'stu te | tālusthe tu mahākāli sarvabhakṣye namo'stu te
śrībhairavyuvāca vakṣyāmi paramaṃ mantraṃ * * * *? vivarjitam | yena siddhāścaturviṃśa bhūmayaḥ svasvarūpataḥ
siddhayoginīdivyaṃ vai kramaṃviddhi samāsataḥ | etat kramaṃ mahāghoraṃ sadyaḥ khegatidāyakam
astraṃ tu kālisaṃjñā *? kṣetrapālamataḥ param | tato divyāmadivyāṃ ca mānavīṃ gurusantatim
yoginyo vyomagāḥ sarvāḥ dvādaśagāḥ samāsataḥ | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi aṣṭau devyo vibhāgaśaḥ
sādhikārāḥ punaḥ pūjyāḥ pratiyuktāstu cātra ṣaṭ | etat kramaṃ tu siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ susādhakam
2/? mahāsthāneśabharitā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | amanā mānasairbhāvaiḥ hīnā manonnatā sadā
śrībhairavyuvāca purā yat kathitaṃ deva pañcadhā saṃkramakramam | teṣāṃ tu kramarājānāṃ sṛṣṭirūpāgrataḥ sadā
ooṃkārāntāntabhāvena jñānaṃ prāpya nabhaṃ gatā | etāstu mūrtayaḥ proktāḥ sarvabhāve tu cāgragāḥ
sakṣunyetiḥ svabhāvākhye viśvagrāsā parā citiḥ | laharīṃ prathamāṃ viddhi śāṃbhavī kālabhakṣakī
guptaṃ tu paramaṃ divyaṃ kimarthaṃ naravandite | etad vadasva me (?) vāme yathāvidhiranukramāt
pujaya? asthikhaṇḍantu pāṇinā sarvathā budhaḥ | dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā ālikheccakramuttamam
pūjanīyāstu vai nityaṃ vīradravyaistu tāḥ sadā | advayācārabhāvena vīrācāreṇa bhairava
ālikhet tu tṛtīyaṃ vai cakraṃ saṃhārakārakam | atyutkaṭaṃ mahādīptaṃ svaraśmiśatasaṃkulam
melāpe militā sā vai rūpasya paramā citiḥ | (3 ) dvātriṃśadvīrasaṃyuktā madhye yā svādinī kalā
paścād bhāsākramāyātāṃ sarvaśāstreṣu gopitaṃ | akṣarā ca arūpā ca kṣarate sarvabhāvagā
tithibhirya sadārūḍhaṃ sapakṣāpakṣavarjitam | niḥsvabhāvanibhau paśya nirlakṣaṃ niṣprayojanam
śrībhairava uvāca devi tvaṃ parameśāni guhyaṃ guhyataraṃ śubham | pṛcchāmi parayā bhaktyā bāhyaṃ guhyamidaṃ param
sṛṣṭisthaṃ saptamaṃ rudra saṃhārasyāṣṭamairyutam | ṣoḍaśaṃ taṃ vijānīyād varṇaṃ varṇeśvareśvaram
saṃhāracakrād deveśa saptamena śiroyutam | saptamaṃ tu vijānīyādaṣṭamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
melāpe militā sā vai ānande paramā citiḥ | (10) saṃkalpasya vikalpasya madhye yā cetanī kalā
sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiśca saṃhāraṃ anākhyaṃ ca caturthakam | bhāsākhyaṃ pañcamaṃ devi tava vaktrāvadhāritam
tārasvaṃ gṛdhvāntaṃ sā vai * tarā sarvadehinām | ekānekatayā bhinnā abhedī bhinnabhāvanī
kṣarate viśvame sviraṃ mātṛkā svarabhedataḥ | pañcāśadbījakhacitaṃ tridhā bhinnaṃ * * * *?
sthiti navamavarṇena śilayā lāṃcchitaṃ kuru | etat piṇḍākṣaraṃ rudra ādau tasmāt samuddharet
tato nityoditāṃ bhīmāṃ amātrāṃ sarvabhāsakāṃ | mātṛkāśca bahiḥsthāpya prāṇasya ca muhurmuhuḥ
mūrtyānāṃ paramā mūrtiḥ ṣoḍaśānāṃ yathārthataḥ | idānīṃ parayā bhaktyā śrotumicchāmi bhairavi
kalate tatra saṃsthā yā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | adhomukhā nirākārā kālākālasya bhakṣakī
yena jñātena me devi nikṛttākleśasaṃtatiḥ | (?) tasya cakra parasyaiva sṛṣṭirūpasya bhairava
tasmāt tvaṃ vīravīrendra pūjako bhava nityaśaḥ | toyena pūjitamātreṇa siddhasantānapāragam
taptā sarvārthagarbhajñā sthitisthā viddhi tattvataḥ | ṣaṭtyāge tu acakrasthā nityā pūjyā vimarśataḥ
athavā yatra yatrecchā mānasī bhavate'aa calā | tatra tatra prakartavyaṃ mantroddhāraṃ svakāmataḥ
evaṃmahārthaṃparamaṃ kramasaṃsthaṃ su gopayet | akramastho mahāvīro gaḥ kaścid bhuvitiṣṭhate
galatālukamadhyasthā antaḥ yāti parā citiḥ | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
śāntajñānena siddhā ca khecakramavalambinī | saptagarbhagatā devī saptasaptaikasaṃsthitā
vadasva paramaṃ jñānaṃ  yat  sthitaṃ me hṛdantare  ||2/7 ||
nirnāśaṃ nirvikārañca niravadyaṃ nirākulam | viśuddhaṃ nirbharaṃ nityaṃ anityaṃ sarvadaiva hi
